alkylation reagent: Fixed modifications were set as carbamidomethyl (C) and variable modifications set as oxidation (M).
cleavage agent: Trypsin digestion of membrane proteins was performed using a filter-aided sample preparation method.
enrichment method: To address this possibility, membrane proteins isolated from the MIND and TMP strains in lag phase were investigated.
instrument: LC–MS/MS was carried out using an RSLCnano HPLC system (Dionex, UK) and an LTQ-Orbitrap-Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
ionization type: with the output of the column sprayed directly into the nanospray ion source of the LTQ-Orbitrap-Velos mass spectrometer.
labeling: For quantitative experiments the digested peptides were labelled with the TMTsixplex Label Reagent kit (Life Sciences) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
